title: Application security fundamentals
summary: Build threat awareness into normal engineering decisions.
why: Build threat awareness into normal engineering decisions.
outcomes: Explain Application security fundamentals in your own words
Implement a small working example of Application security fundamentals
Debug a realistic failure related to Application security fundamentals
lab: Attack a deliberately vulnerable local app for injection, XSS, CSRF and access-control bugs, then harden it.
